task: FAL-280 (slice C of the FAL-271 art audit)
method: Edit the shipped image, never draw fresh. Each cut creature (webp as shipped) was padded on its cut side, enlarged 4x and given a qwen21_edit "complete only the cut part, keep everything else exactly as it is" edit, 2 seeds per edit. Pillow scaled the pick back to the shipped pixel scale, so faces and props keep their size; the build only trims it. The old sheet figures are set to null in tools/assets/sheets.json, and the original sheets tremendoodle-swiftlet.png and altmanta-beastie.png are kept unchanged.
why_cut: The source sheets packed the poses so tightly that the island splitter sliced off hair, tail, wing and fur, or kept a slice of the neighbouring pose.
rounds: Round 1 (seeds 28001, 28002): 5 edits x 2 seeds. Picks: tremendoodle-attack #1, tremendoodle-defeated #4, beastie-angry #9. Both altmanta edits made the wing ~320 px wide (altmanta-smug is 260), which would draw the face ~30 % smaller in the square object-fit: contain portrait boxes: rejected.
Round 2 (seeds 28101, 28102): altmanta only, left pad 42 % -> 18 % and a short wing tip. altmanta-defeated #3 accepted; both altmanta-angry renders kept a blunt squared wing end: rejected.

Round 3 (seeds 28201, 28202): altmanta-angry only, qwen21_ref with a wing-tip reference image (A: altmanta-defeated-163, B: shipped altmanta-smug), arrowhead wording, pad 25 %. #1 (reference A) accepted.
measured: All picks register on the shipped pixels at (0, 0) px with a mean colour change of 2.5-3.5/255 in the untouched part. Heights match the shipped ones within 1-2 px. No new detached clumps.
